name: Pulsar
author: Erin Carter
description: A fixed scatter of small hash stars twinkles arrhythmically across a near-black void while one distinguished point flashes with perfect clockwork regularity — a soft-haloed beacon, the lone metronome in a field of noise.

params.label: Pulse period
params.effect: Seconds between pulsar flashes; the metronome runs from urgent to stately.

params.label: Flash size
params.effect: Radius of the pulsar's halo at peak flash in CSS pixels, from a tight pinprick blink to a frame-washing beacon.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: Per-cell hash threshold for the irregular twinklers, from a near-empty sky to a richly populated field.
